_comment: Hierarchische Prüfung. Grundfakten: Ja/Nein-Fragen, die Kev zu jedem Anruf beantwortet ('instructions' ist die Frage, die Kev liest); ein Fakt gilt als ja, wenn p(yes) die Schwelle erreicht (eine Schwelle für alle, in den Einstellungen änderbar). Regeln: Kombinationen der Fakten; 'conditions' legt pro Fakt 'ja' oder 'nein' fest, nicht genannte Fakten sind egal. Eine Regel löst aus, wenn alle Bedingungen erfüllt sind; löst mindestens eine aus, gibt es einen Alarm. 'label' (Fakt) und 'name' (Regel) sind nur Anzeige.

trade_wish.label: Kauf- oder Verkaufswunsch
trade_wish.instructions: Does someone express their own wish to buy or sell a financial instrument at any point in the call? A later refusal or non-execution does not change the answer.

nonpublic_info.label: Stützt sich auf nicht öffentliche Information
nonpublic_info.instructions: Does someone rely on information that is not yet public? Information that has already been published counts as no.

info_passed_on.label: Gibt Insiderinformation weiter
info_passed_on.instructions: Does someone pass on non-public, price-relevant information to another person, or recommend a trade based on it?

price_influence.label: Zweck: Kurs beeinflussen
price_influence.instructions: Is the purpose of an order or of spreading information to move or fix a market price or to fake trading activity?

credential_read_out.label: Zugangsgeheimnis ausgesprochen
credential_read_out.instructions: Does someone actually say out loud a secret that grants access or confirms a transaction? Only mentioning or refusing it counts as no.

credential_valid.label: Geheimnis gültig
credential_valid.instructions: Is the secret that was said out loud currently valid for an ongoing process of its owner? Expired values and samples from instructions count as no.

credential_asked.label: Fragt nach fremdem Zugangsgeheimnis
credential_asked.instructions: Does someone ask another person for that person's access secret?

third_party_data.label: Geschützte Daten einer Drittperson
third_party_data.instructions: Is the call about protected account or personal data of a third person?

no_authorization.label: Keine Berechtigung festgestellt
no_authorization.instructions: Has the bank established that there is no authorization for this specific information? A confirmed authorization counts as no.

third_party_data_revealed.label: Bank nennt geschütztes Detail
third_party_data_revealed.instructions: Does the bank actually reveal a protected detail about the third person?

third_party_data_requested.label: Verlangt geschützte Daten
third_party_data_requested.instructions: Does someone ask to be told protected data of a third person?

omission_request.label: Wunsch, Angabe wegzulassen
omission_request.instructions: Does someone ask for a piece of information to be deliberately left out of, or hidden in, the documentation for an internal decision-making body? A mere correction counts as no.

relevant_fact.label: Angabe ist relevant und wahr
relevant_fact.instructions: Is the information in question a true fact that is relevant for the decision? False or unrelated information counts as no.

false_record_request.label: Will Falsches festhalten
false_record_request.instructions: Does someone want information recorded that they know to be false?

split_request.label: Aufteilung angefragt
split_request.instructions: Does someone ask for a payment, deposit or booking to be split into partial amounts?

single_transaction.label: Gehört zu einem einzigen Vorgang
single_transaction.instructions: Do the partial amounts belong to one single invoice, delivery or transaction? Independent genuine invoices count as no.

control_motive.label: Zweck: interne Kontrolle verhindern
control_motive.instructions: Is it stated that the purpose of splitting is to prevent an internal approval or control from being applied?

control_bypass.label: Versucht Kontrolle auszulassen
control_bypass.instructions: Does someone try to skip or switch off an internal approval, limit or control so that it is not applied at all?

reporting_motive.label: Zweck: Meldepflicht vermeiden
reporting_motive.instructions: Is the purpose of splitting to keep a legal reporting or identification obligation from applying?

funds_origin_topic.label: Herkunft von Vermögen ist Thema
funds_origin_topic.instructions: Is the origin of assets or incoming funds discussed?

origin_concealed.label: Herkunft wird verschleiert
origin_concealed.instructions: Does someone evade, refuse or deliberately obscure the explanation of where the assets come from?

beneficiary_topic.label: Berechtigung an Vermögen ist Thema
beneficiary_topic.instructions: Is it discussed who owns assets or who benefits from them?

beneficiary_hidden.label: Wahrer Berechtigter soll verborgen bleiben
beneficiary_hidden.instructions: Is the person who actually owns or benefits from the assets to be kept hidden from the bank?

advantage_offered.label: Persönlicher Vorteil angeboten oder verlangt
advantage_offered.instructions: Does someone offer or ask for a personal advantage?

quid_pro_quo.label: Vorteil gegen Handlung
quid_pro_quo.instructions: Is the advantage tied to an action in return?

third_party_instruction.label: Handelt auf Anweisung oder Druck Dritter
third_party_instruction.instructions: Does someone act, or want to act, on the instruction of or under pressure from a third person?

deception_signs.label: Anzeichen von Täuschung durch Dritte
deception_signs.instructions: Are there clear signs that this third person is deceiving or exploiting them?
